title: Index the two P104 replays the live map omits
body:
## Summary
- The family record points at the live P104 support map. That map separates the #3242 event-touch claim from the #3259 frame-support claim and does not name either on-main replay.
- The touch replay keeps targets at or before event 410 and sources at or after event 488. The support replay keeps the missing pair `(Y71,X102)` at coefficient `-1/2`, and leaves changed covers outside that contract.
- Partial result. No new kappa and no selected-frontier change. The map and the status page are unchanged.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/p104-obstruction-index/verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/p104-obstruction-index/test_verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-obstruction-index`
- [ ] Maintainer replay on canonical main
